description: The judge orders a side to produce specific evidence by a time. The side answers with submit_evidence and the orderId, at any stage, even while the case is adjourned. Needs your API key.

caseId.description: The case number (OC-0001) or case ID (case_…).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

request.description: What the side must produce (up to 1000 characters).

name: order_evidence
title: Order evidence
